name: Aarti Drugs Ltd
title: Aarti Drugs Ltd - 524348 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 13.4% with Sayakha methylamine utilisation ~40% in March and FY27 margin target 13.5–14%, but salicylic acid shut and export revenue down 7% YoY.

capex.quote: we feel that at least in the next two to three years, definitely around INR300 crores to INR400 crores of capex might go in

triggers.label: Methylamine utilisation ~40% in March
triggers.quote: we were able to achieve utilization upwards of 40%

triggers.label: API prices elevated; stable now
triggers.quote: Prices are now stable. We don't -- we are not expecting any further increase in the price.

triggers.label: Salicylic acid production shut
triggers.quote: We took a call to shut that production.

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 13.5–14% vs earlier 14–14.5%
triggers.quote: we would still like to target EBITDA margins anywhere between 13.5% to 14% for this FY 2027

guidance.quote: Had this war not been there, our earlier targets were definitely 14% to 14.5% EBITDA margin for FY 2027.

guidance.value: 55-60% in June quarter; 70% within a year
guidance.quote: we should easily cross around 55%, 60% of utilization for that plant

guidance.value: at least INR1,000 crores in next 3-5 years
guidance.quote: we are expecting to grow our formulation business at least till INR1,000 crores in the next three to five years
around INR300 crores to INR400 crores of capex might go in
we will always strive for achieving a volume growth of 8% to 10%

red_flags.label: Salicylic acid plant shut; variable losses
red_flags.quote: because we were making variable losses in salicylic acid

red_flags.label: Export revenue down 7% YoY standalone
red_flags.quote: whereas export revenue declined by 7% year-on-year

evasions.topic: Sayakha ramp-up internal vs external split
evasions.quote: As far as internal problems are concerned, there are very minor issues
Volumes probably can be a bit flattish
